infoYearT1.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/6] The final wave of data collection took place in 2014. Ages of participants were as follows: Wave 1 (fifth grade): mean 10.86, range 9-13

yearT1.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/6] Data for this study were part of a larger study assessing the development of dysfunctional behaviours during the preadolescent to early adolescent years. In the larger study, the sample of 1,906 U.S. children participated over nine waves: every 6 months from the spring of fifth grade (the last year of elementary school) through the spring of eighth grade (the last year of middle school) and then in the spring of ninth and 10th grades. The final wave of data collection took place in 2014.
yearT1.warning: Derived from the timeline: Wave 9 (Spring 10th grade) = Spring 2014. Working backward: W8 (Spring 9th) = Spring 2013, W7 (Spring 8th) = Spring 2012, W6 (Fall 7th) = Fall 2011, W5 (Spring 7th) = Spring 2011, W4 (Fall 6th) = Fall 2010, W3 (Spring 6th) = Spring 2010, W2 (Fall 5th) = Fall 2009, W1 (Spring 5th) = Spring 2009.
